ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the figure, the four polylines 1, 2, 3, and 4 represent the seasonal variation of noon solar altitude in four places, and curve 5 represents the variation of day length with the seasons in one of the four places. <image1> According to the diagram, the relationship of the rotational linear velocities of the four places is ______.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the horizontal axis in the figure successively marks the spring equinox, summer solstice, autumn equinox, winter solstice, and spring equinox; 1, 2, 3, and 4 are polylines of the seasonal variation of noon solar altitude in four places, and 5 is the day length variation curve. Observe the vertical line positions corresponding to the spring equinox or autumn equinox; the height relationship of the four noon solar altitude polylines is: 1 is the highest, 2 is second, and 3 and 4 are equal and lower than 2. Then reason: at the spring equinox and autumn equinox, the Sun directly shines on the equator, and the noon solar altitude H=90°-|latitude| at a place; therefore, the larger the noon solar altitude at the spring and autumn equinoxes, the smaller the absolute value of the latitude of that place. The Earth’s rotational linear velocity v=ωRcosφ; the smaller the absolute value of latitude, the greater the rotational linear velocity. From the figure, |φ1|<|φ2|<|φ3|=|φ4|, so the relationship of the rotational linear velocities of the four places is 1>2>3=4.

method.method_draft: 先读图：横轴标出春分、夏至、秋分、冬至、春分，1、2、3、4为四地正午太阳高度折线。重点看春分或秋分这两条竖线处四条折线的相对高度：图中1的正午太阳高度最高，2次之，3和4在春秋分时对应的正午太阳高度相等且低于2。再读题干：要求比较四地自转线速度。桥接规则：春秋分太阳直射赤道，某地正午太阳高度 H=90°-|纬度|，所以春秋分正午太阳高度越大，纬度绝对值越小；地球自转线速度 v=ωRcosφ，纬度绝对值越小线速度越大。由图得 |φ1|<|φ2|<|φ3|=|φ4|，所以线速度关系为1>2>3=4。
